mapper.sql: c.id, c.conversation_id, c.title, c.user_id, c.provider, c.model, c.model_id, c.last_message_time, c.message_count, c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.deleted, m.display_name AS model_display_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM chat_conversations c LEFT JOIN ai_model m ON m.id = c.model_id WHERE c.conversation_id = #{conversationId}
SELECT FROM chat_conversations c LEFT JOIN ai_model m ON m.id = c.model_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.deleted = #{deleted} ORDER BY c.last_message_time DESC
SELECT FROM chat_conversations c LEFT JOIN ai_model m ON m.id = c.model_id WHERE c.deleted = #{deleted} ORDER BY c.last_message_time DESC
